'''Relics''' were sacred artifacts from all over [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] collected by the [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]]. The Aing-Tii took the relics to [[Aing-Tii homeworld|their homeworld]] and placed them in the [[Embrace]], a series of caverns on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. They were forbidden to touch the sacred relics, but outsiders were not. For this reason, the Aing-Tii often enlisted the help of others, such as [[Jorj Car'das]], to retrieve the relics.

In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]], traveled to the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]] to find the Aing-Tii in hopes of learning more about [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo's]] fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. They were taken to the Aing-Tii [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] by [[Tadar'Ro]], who eventually took them to the Embrace, with the hopes that they would find a revelation from the relics that would settle the tensions that had recently risen among the Aing-Tii. Luke touched the [[Codex]], a relic that could increase the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]] of the user. This caused the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], a group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] marooned on the planet of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] about [[5000 BBY/Legends|5,000]] years earlier, to sense Skywalker's presence and hear his name through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].

The relics revealed no revelation to the Skywalkers, and the Aing-Tii were left to solve their internal problems on their own.
